messages:
pat_ops: HyperFreight emailed availability update for H100 tranche. Lead time 4-6 weeks, but they can air-priority 25 units in 48-72h if we accept forwarder premium and sign a 14-day deposit.
mia_fin: How high is the premium? Need numbers before we commit deposit.
violet_hyperfreight: Violet (HyperFreight): Air-priority fee = +11% per unit (includes AWB priority and handling). Sea remainder holds at committed price. We also offer a conditional RMA credit voucher for DOA up to 3% if deposit signed. Voucher covers courier + refurb credit and is redeemable at depot.
oliver_procure: 3% voucher low. Ops prefers swapped units on arrival. Are we able to insist on immediate replacements for DOA above 1%?
pat_ops: Conditional plan: accept 25 air units if vendor 1) shares AWB within 12h, 2) adds depot photo checklist to RMA SLA, 3) agrees to immediate on-site swap for DOA>1% or reimburse courier expedite.
ship-bot: Required docs: AWB, commercial invoice, HS code 8471.90, packing list, thermal pack cert for sea shipments.
violet_hyperfreight: We can accept those conditions except the immediate swap guarantee for DOA>1% without extra cost. We'll commit to expedite replacement at cost if DOA rate exceeds 3%. Voucher stands otherwise.
mia_fin: Approve deposit up to $180k to secure 25 units at +11%. Finance will set a contingency to cover replacement expedite if vendor triggers >3% DOA.
oliver_procure: Split request: send 15 to us-west pool, 10 to us-east. Hold sea batch for remaining 30 units on standard window.
pat_ops: Please include a clause: "Depot to provide photo evidence within 6h of arrival for any suspected DOA" and add KMS whitelist notice 48h prior to handoff. We've had handoff blocks before.
violet_hyperfreight: Adding clause and will attach draft RMA + voucher template in reply. AWB tentative HX-PR720, will confirm once deposit acknowledged.
pat_ops: Sounds good. Once RMA is in, we'll wire deposit and confirm AWB recipients and customs PO. Keep us posted.
